import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Load the data
coffee_sales = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Convert date column to datetime
coffee_sales['date'] = pd.to_datetime(coffee_sales['date'])

# Group by product and size, then calculate total sales
product_sales = coffee_sales.groupby(['product', 'size']).total.sum().reset_index()

# Sort the sales in descending order
product_sales = product_sales.sort_values('total', ascending=False)

# Select top 5 products
top_products = product_sales.nlargest(5, 'total')

# Create a bar plot of top products
plt.figure(figsize=(10,6))
sns.barplot(x='product', y='total', data=top_products)
plt.title('Top 5 Coffee Product Sales')
plt.xlabel('Product')
plt.ylabel('Total Sales')
plt.xticks(rotation=45)
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
